user-test-toolkit v3.1.0

- Added comprehensive configuration docs, including full tracker/survey APIs and settings.
- New default setup and quick-start examples in both Chinese and English.
- Expanded and clarified tracker/survey configuration options and event types.
- Documented new features: multi-dimensional behavior tracking, in-flow checkpoint surveys, emotion models (SUS/EV/NPS/SAM), and workflow examples for different test modes.
- Updated API and file structure sections for easier customization and integration.
